EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.events) e WHERE e->>'type' = 'tool_call' AND e->>'tool_name' = 'chunk_search')
t.conversation_id AS conversation_id, t.seq AS seq, t.user_input AS user_input, AS intent, AS action, AS tool_rounds, t.duration_ms AS duration_ms, t.degraded AS degraded, t.created_at AS created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id AS id, c.created_at AS created_at, c.last_active_at AS last_active_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id) AS message_count FROM tb_ai_conversation c WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.last_active_at >= #{startTime}
AND c.last_active_at <= #{endTime}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id AND = #{intent})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id AND = #{action})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id AND t.user_input ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY c.last_active_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.created_at AS created_at, c.last_active_at AS last_active_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id) AS message_count FROM tb_ai_conversation c WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT t.seq AS seq, t.user_input AS user_input, t.answer AS answer, AS intent, AS action, AS tool_rounds, t.duration_ms AS duration_ms, t.degraded AS degraded, t.created_at AS created_at, t.events AS events, t.prompt AS prompt FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY t.seq
SELECT AS label, count(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT AS label, count(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT e->>'tool_name' AS label, count(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_turn t, jsonb_array_elements(t.events) e WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} AND e->>'type' = 'tool_call' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT AS label, count(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} AND = 'REFUSE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

choose.when: SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('hour', NOW() - INTERVAL '23 hours'), date_trunc('hour', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 hour') AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS bucket_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_ai_conversation WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', created_at) ) c ON c.bucket_key = bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '29 days'), date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day') AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS bucket_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_ai_conversation WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ) c ON c.bucket_key = bucket ORDER BY bucket
choose.otherwise: SELECT bucket::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS count FROM generate_series( date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '6 days'), date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day') AS bucket LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS bucket_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_ai_conversation WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ) c ON c.bucket_key = bucket ORDER BY bucket

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_conversation c WHERE c.last_active_at >= #{from}) AS conversation_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from}) AS question_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} AND = 'REFUSE') AS refused_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_turn t WHERE t.created_at >= #{from} AND ) AS fallback_count
